subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

My name is Amy. I am a student. I get up at 6:30 every morning. I eat breakfast at 7:00. Then I go to school at 7:30. I have four classes in the morning and two in the afternoon. I like English best. After school, I play basketball with my friends. I go home at 5:00. I do my homework first, then watch TV. I go to bed at 9:00.

(1) Amy gets up at seven o'clock in the morning. (　)
(2) She has six classes every day. (　)
(3) Her favorite subject is English. (　)
(4) She plays football after school. (　)
(5) She goes to bed at nine in the evening. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查短文细节信息的提取和判断。
【解题思路】逐句定位原文信息进行比对。
【总结】判断正误题要仔细比对原文，注意数字、时间、人物、动作等细节，不能凭印象。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Dear Tom,
How are you? I'm writing to tell you about my school. Our school is big and beautiful. There is a large playground. We often play sports there. There is a library with many books. I like reading storybooks. There is also a music room and an art room. We have music and art classes every week. My favorite day is Friday because we have a science class. Science is very interesting.

Yours,
Mike

(1) The school has a ______ playground.
A. small B. large C. new D. old

(2) Mike likes reading ______.
A. science books B. storybooks C. art books D. music books

(3) Mike's favorite day is ______.
A. Monday B. Wednesday C. Friday D. Sunday

(4) Why does Mike like Friday?
A. Because he has music class. B. Because he has art class.
C. Because he has science class. D. Because he can play sports.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查短文细节理解和信息提取。
【解题思路】从文中找到对应句子。
【总结】选择题答案在原文中可直接找到，定位关键词如large, storybooks, Friday, science class。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，用完整的英语句子回答问题。

My name is Li Hua. I live in Chongqing. It's a big city. Last weekend, I went to the zoo with my parents. We saw many animals. The pandas were very cute. They ate bamboo. The monkeys were funny. They jumped up and down. My mother took some photos. We stayed there for three hours. Then we went to a restaurant and had lunch. I ate noodles. It was a happy day.

(1) Where does Li Hua live?
________________________________________
(2) Who did Li Hua go to the zoo with?
________________________________________
(3) What did the pandas eat?
________________________________________
(4) How long did they stay at the zoo?
________________________________________
(5) What did Li Hua eat for lunch?
________________________________________
answer:
(1) He lives in Chongqing.
(2) He went to the zoo with his parents.
(3) The pandas ate bamboo.
(4) They stayed there for three hours.
(5) He ate noodles.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查根据短文内容回答问题。
【解题思路】从文中找到对应信息，用完整句子回答。
【总结】回答问题时，注意人称和时态要与原文一致。问Where用in+地点，问Who用with，问What用具体内容，问How long用for+时间。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，将下列事件按文中发生的顺序排序（1-5）。

Yesterday was Sunday. I had a busy day. I got up at 7:00. Then I had breakfast at 7:30. After breakfast, I did my homework. It took me two hours. At 10:30, I went to the library. I borrowed two books. Then I went home at 11:30. In the afternoon, I visited my grandparents. We had dinner together at 6:00. In the evening, I watched TV for an hour. Then I went to bed at 9:00.

事件：
A. Visited grandparents.
B. Did homework.
C. Went to the library.
D. Watched TV.
E. Had breakfast.

正确的顺序是：____ → ____ → ____ → ____ → ____
analysis:
【考点】本题考查对事件顺序的理解和排序。
【解题思路】按时间顺序找出事件先后：吃早餐→做作业→去图书馆→看望祖父母→看电视。
【总结】排序题要抓住时间顺序词（first, then, after that, later, finally）或具体时间点。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

It is winter now. The weather is very cold. Snow is falling. The children are very happy. They can make snowmen and play with snow. Some are throwing snowballs. Look at Tom and Mike. They are making a big snowman. They put a carrot as its nose and two stones as its eyes. They also put a hat on its head. It looks funny. The children are laughing.

根据短文内容，选择正确答案。
(1) What season is it?
A. Spring B. Summer C. Autumn D. Winter

(2) What are the children doing?
A. They are making snowmen and playing with snow.
B. They are swimming in the river.
C. They are flying kites.
D. They are reading books.

判断正误。
(3) Tom and Mike are making a big snowman. (　)
(4) They put an apple as the snowman's nose. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查短文细节理解。
【解题思路】根据原文信息判断。
【总结】混合型题目要分别对待，选择题在选项中找匹配，判断题需仔细比对细节。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

There are four seasons in a year. They are spring, summer, autumn and winter. Spring is warm. Trees turn green and flowers come out. Summer is hot. People like to go swimming. Autumn is cool. It is a harvest season. Farmers are busy picking apples and pears. Winter is cold. Children like to make snowmen and skate.

(1) How many seasons are there in a year?
A. Three B. Four C. Five D. Six

(2) What season is warm?
A. Spring B. Summer C. Autumn D. Winter

(3) What do people like to do in summer?
A. Make snowmen B. Go swimming C. Pick apples D. Fly kites

(4) Why are farmers busy in autumn?
A. Because it is cold. B. Because they are planting trees.
C. Because it is a harvest season. D. Because they like to work.

(5) What do children like to do in winter?
A. Go swimming B. Pick apples C. Make snowmen D. Fly kites
analysis:
【考点】本题考查季节相关词汇及细节理解。
【解题思路】逐题在文中定位信息。
【总结】细节题直接找原文对应句子，注意同义表达（如harvest season = busy）。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

Tom is a student. He is twelve years old. He is in Class 5, Grade 6. His favorite subject is PE because he likes playing basketball. After school, he often plays basketball with his classmates. He also likes reading. He reads storybooks every night before going to bed. His favorite book is The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. He wants to be a writer in the future.

(1) Tom is thirteen years old. (　)
(2) Tom's favorite subject is PE. (　)
(3) He plays basketball after school. (　)
(4) He reads storybooks every morning. (　)
(5) He wants to be a teacher. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查细节判断。
【解题思路】与原文逐句比对。
【总结】注意数字、时间、人物、职业等关键信息的准确比对。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，用完整的英语句子回答问题。

My school is very big and beautiful. There are three buildings. The classroom building is in the middle. The library is on the left. The gym is on the right. There is a large playground behind the classroom building. We have PE class there. I like my school very much.

(1) How many buildings are there in the school?
________________________________________
(2) Where is the library?
________________________________________
(3) What is behind the classroom building?
________________________________________
(4) Does the writer like his/her school?
________________________________________
answer:
(1) There are three buildings.
(2) The library is on the left.
(3) A large playground is behind the classroom building.
(4) Yes, he/she does. / Yes, the writer likes his/her school very much.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查方位描述及数量信息的提取。
【解题思路】从文中直接找到答案，注意句子完整性。
【总结】回答Where问题要给出具体方位词（on the left/right, in the middle, behind）；回答How many用数字；一般疑问句用Yes/No开头。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，将下列事件按文中发生的顺序排序（1-5）。

Yesterday was my birthday. I had a great day. First, I woke up at 7:00 and found a gift on my desk. It was a new watch from my parents. Then I had breakfast with my family. After breakfast, I went to school. My friends sang a birthday song to me. At lunchtime, we ate a big cake together. After school, I went to the cinema with my best friend. We watched a funny movie. In the evening, my parents took me to a restaurant. We had a delicious dinner. Finally, I went to bed at 10:00. I was very happy.

事件：
A. Watched a movie at the cinema.
B. Ate a big cake at lunchtime.
C. Had dinner at a restaurant.
D. Found a gift on the desk.
E. Friends sang a birthday song.

正确的顺序是：____ → ____ → ____ → ____ → ____
analysis:
【考点】本题考查事件顺序的排列。
【解题思路】按时间顺序：发现礼物→朋友唱生日歌→吃蛋糕→看电影→餐厅吃晚饭。
【总结】注意顺序词：first, then, after that, in the evening, finally。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

Many people like to keep pets. Pets are good friends. Dogs are loyal. They can guard the house. Cats are quiet and clean. They like to sleep on the sofa. Birds can sing beautiful songs. Fish are easy to look after. They just need food and clean water. Keeping pets can make people happy. But you need to take care of them. They need food, water and love.

(1) What is the main idea of this passage?
A. Different kinds of pets.
B. How to feed fish.
C. Pets are good friends and need care.
D. Dogs are better than cats.

(2) Which pet can guard the house?
A. Cat B. Bird C. Dog D. Fish

(3) What do fish need?
A. A big house B. Songs C. Food and clean water D. A sofa

(4) According to the passage, keeping pets can make people ______.
A. sad B. tired C. happy D. busy
analysis:
【考点】本题考查主旨大意和细节理解。
【解题思路】主旨从首尾句提炼，细节在文中定位。
【总结】主旨题关注首段、尾段或反复出现的词；细节题定位关键词。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

It was a sunny day yesterday. Lily and her mother went to the beach. They took an umbrella, a towel and some food. The beach was crowded. Many people were swimming in the sea. Some children were building sandcastles. Lily played volleyball with her new friends. Her mother sat under the umbrella and read a book. They had lunch at 12:00. They ate sandwiches and drank orange juice. They went home at 3:00 in the afternoon. Lily was tired but happy.

(1) It was rainy yesterday. (　)
(2) Lily and her mother went to the beach. (　)
(3) Lily played basketball with her friends. (　)
(4) They had lunch at 2:00. (　)
(5) Lily was happy at the end of the day. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查细节理解和信息提取。
【解题思路】逐句与原文比对。
【总结】注意否定词和动作的准确对应，如“sunny”不等于“rainy”，“volleyball”不等于“basketball”。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

My name is Sarah. I am from Canada. Now I live in Beijing with my parents. My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital. My mother is a teacher. She teaches English in a primary school. I am a student. I study at Beijing International School. I like Chinese food very much. My favorite food is dumplings. I also like pandas. They are very cute. On weekends, I often go to the zoo to see them.

(1) Where is Sarah from?
A. China B. Canada C. America D. Australia

(2) What does Sarah's mother do?
A. She is a doctor. B. She is a nurse.
C. She is a teacher. D. She is a student.

(3) What is Sarah's favorite food?
A. Noodles B. Rice C. Dumplings D. Hamburgers

(4) What animal does Sarah like?
A. Monkeys B. Pandas C. Elephants D. Tigers

(5) Where does Sarah often go on weekends?
A. To the park B. To the library C. To the zoo D. To the cinema
analysis:
【考点】本题考查个人信息提取。
【解题思路】在文中定位关键词。
【总结】人物介绍类阅读，答案往往直接出现在文中，注意同义表达（如“like” = “favorite”）。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，用完整的英语句子回答问题。

Hi, I'm Tom. I'm going to have a busy weekend. On Saturday morning, I'm going to do my homework. Then I'm going to play football with my friends in the park. In the afternoon, I'm going to visit my grandparents. They live in the countryside. On Sunday morning, I'm going to help my mother clean the house. In the afternoon, I'm going to read a storybook. In the evening, I'm going to watch a movie with my family.

(1) What is Tom going to do on Saturday morning?
________________________________________
(2) Where is Tom going to play football?
________________________________________
(3) Who is Tom going to visit on Saturday afternoon?
________________________________________
(4) What is Tom going to do on Sunday morning?
________________________________________
(5) When is Tom going to watch a movie?
________________________________________
answer:
(1) He is going to do his homework.
(2) He is going to play football in the park.
(3) He is going to visit his grandparents.
(4) He is going to help his mother clean the house.
(5) He is going to watch a movie on Sunday evening.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查be going to结构的理解和信息提取。
【解题思路】从文中找到对应时间点的活动。
【总结】回答将来时问题，要用完整句，保持be going to结构。注意介词短语（in the park, on Sunday evening）不能遗漏。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，将下列事件按文中发生的顺序排序（1-5）。

Last Saturday, my family went to a restaurant for dinner. When we arrived, a waiter showed us to a table. First, we looked at the menu. Then the waiter came and asked, “May I take your order?” My father ordered beef noodles. My mother ordered vegetable salad. I ordered fried rice. After a while, the food arrived. It looked delicious. We ate happily. At the end of the meal, my father paid the bill. Then we left the restaurant.

事件：
A. The waiter took their order.
B. They looked at the menu.
C. They left the restaurant.
D. The father paid the bill.
E. They ate the food.

正确的顺序是：____ → ____ → ____ → ____ → ____
analysis:
【考点】本题考查餐厅用餐流程的顺序。
【解题思路】按事件发展：看菜单→点餐→吃饭→付钱→离开。
【总结】注意顺序词：first, then, after a while, at the end of the meal, then。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Elephants are the largest land animals on Earth. They have big ears and long trunks. They use their trunks to drink water, pick up food, and even take a shower. Elephants are very smart. They can remember places and people for a long time. They live in groups. The mother elephant takes care of the baby elephants. Elephants eat grass, leaves, and fruits. They need to eat a lot because they are so big. Now, many elephants are in danger because people cut down forests.

(1) What is the largest land animal on Earth?
A. Giraffe B. Lion C. Elephant D. Tiger

(2) What do elephants use their trunks to do?
A. To drink water B. To pick up food
C. To take a shower D. All of the above

(3) Why do elephants need to eat a lot?
A. Because they are smart. B. Because they are big.
C. Because they live in groups. D. Because they like to eat.

(4) Why are many elephants in danger?
A. Because people hunt them. B. Because people cut down forests.
C. Because they have no food. D. Because they are too big.

(5) What is the main idea of this passage?
A. Elephants are dangerous. B. Elephants are small animals.
C. Elephants are smart and in danger. D. Elephants only eat grass.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查说明文的细节和主旨理解。
【解题思路】逐题定位。
【总结】说明文常考动物特征、原因和主旨。注意因果关系词because。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

My school day starts at 8:00. I have six classes every day. Each class is 40 minutes long. I have a 10-minute break between classes. At 12:00, I have lunch. I usually eat in the school cafeteria. My favorite subject is science. I like doing experiments. After school, I join the art club. I like drawing pictures. I go home at 5:00. Then I do my homework. I usually finish my homework before dinner. I go to bed at 9:30.

(1) The writer has six classes every day. (　)
(2) Each class is 30 minutes long. (　)
(3) The writer's favorite subject is math. (　)
(4) The writer joins the art club after school. (　)
(5) The writer goes to bed at 9:00. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查学校生活细节判断。
【解题思路】与原文逐句比对。
【总结】注意数字（40 vs 30）、学科名称（science vs math）和时间（9:30 vs 9:00）的准确比对。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Last Sunday, I went shopping with my mother. We went to a new shopping mall. First, we went to the clothes shop. My mother wanted to buy a dress. She tried on three dresses. Finally, she chose a blue one. It was 200 yuan. Then we went to the bookstore. I bought a storybook. It was 35 yuan. After that, we went to the supermarket. We bought some apples, bananas, and milk. We also bought a cake for my father's birthday. We spent about two hours in the mall. Then we went home by taxi.

(1) Where did they go first?
A. Bookstore B. Supermarket C. Clothes shop D. Restaurant

(2) How much was the dress?
A. 35 yuan B. 200 yuan C. 235 yuan D. 100 yuan

(3) What did the writer buy?
A. A dress B. A cake C. A storybook D. Apples

(4) Why did they buy a cake?
A. Because it was cheap. B. Because it was for the writer's birthday.
C. Because it was for the writer's father's birthday. D. Because they were hungry.

(5) How did they go home?
A. By bus B. By taxi C. By car D. On foot
analysis:
【考点】本题考查购物场景的细节理解。
【解题思路】按顺序定位信息。
【总结】注意顺序词first/then/after that，以及价格、物品、目的等关键信息。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，用完整的英语句子回答问题。

Last summer, I went to Sanya with my family. We went there by plane. It was my first time on a plane. I was very excited. We stayed in a hotel near the beach. Every morning, we went to the beach. I swam in the sea and built sandcastles. My parents took many photos. We also ate seafood. It was delicious. One day, we went to a butterfly park. I saw many beautiful butterflies. We stayed in Sanya for five days. Then we flew back home. I had a wonderful time.

(1) How did they go to Sanya?
________________________________________
(2) Where did they stay?
________________________________________
(3) What did the writer do on the beach?
________________________________________
(4) What did they eat?
________________________________________
(5) How long did they stay in Sanya?
________________________________________
answer:
(1) They went there by plane.
(2) They stayed in a hotel near the beach.
(3) He/She swam in the sea and built sandcastles.
(4) They ate seafood.
(5) They stayed there for five days.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查假期旅行信息提取。
【解题思路】从文中找到对应句子。
【总结】回答交通工具用by + 名词；回答地点用介词短语；回答时间用for + 时间段。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，将下列步骤按文中顺序排序（1-5）。

How to make a fruit salad? First, wash the fruits. You can use apples, bananas, oranges, and strawberries. Next, peel the bananas and oranges. Then, cut all the fruits into small pieces. After that, put the fruits into a big bowl. Finally, add some yogurt and mix well. Now you can enjoy your delicious fruit salad!

步骤：
A. Add yogurt and mix.
B. Cut the fruits into pieces.
C. Wash the fruits.
D. Put the fruits into a bowl.
E. Peel the bananas and oranges.

正确的顺序是：____ → ____ → ____ → ____ → ____
analysis:
【考点】本题考查说明文中的顺序词。
【解题思路】按first, next, then, after that, finally的顺序对应步骤。
【总结】制作流程类阅读，关注顺序词和动作动词。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

Today many people use the Internet. It is very useful. We can send emails to our friends. We can watch movies and listen to music. We can also find information for our homework. But we need to be careful. Some people use the Internet to do bad things. Never give your password to others. Don't talk to strangers online. And don't spend too much time on the Internet. It is bad for your eyes and health.

(1) What is the main idea of this passage?
A. How to play games online.
B. The Internet is useful but we need to be careful.
C. How to send emails.
D. The Internet is bad.

(2) What can we do on the Internet according to the passage?
A. Send emails B. Watch movies C. Find information D. All of the above

(3) Why should we not give our password to others?
A. Because it's a secret. B. Because some people may do bad things.
C. Because the Internet is slow. D. Because passwords are useless.

(4) What is bad for your eyes and health?
A. Watching movies B. Sending emails
C. Spending too much time on the Internet D. Talking to friends

(5) What should you do if a stranger talks to you online?
A. Talk back B. Give your phone number
C. Don't talk to them D. Send them a gift
analysis:
【考点】本题考查主旨大意、细节理解和推理判断。
【解题思路】主旨从首尾句和转折词but判断；细节直接定位；推理从建议句得出。
【总结】主旨题关注转折词（but, however）后面的内容；推理题根据文中建议句判断。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

My name is Lucy. I have many hobbies. I like drawing pictures. I draw every day after school. I also like playing the piano. I have piano lessons on Saturday mornings. My brother, Jack, likes playing football. He plays football with his friends every weekend. My mother likes cooking. She can make delicious cakes. My father likes reading newspapers. He reads them every evening. We all have different hobbies, and we enjoy them very much.

(1) Lucy likes drawing pictures. (　)
(2) Lucy has piano lessons on Sunday mornings. (　)
(3) Jack is Lucy's brother. (　)
(4) Lucy's mother likes reading newspapers. (　)
(5) Lucy's father reads newspapers every evening. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查家庭成员爱好的细节判断。
【解题思路】逐句与原文比对，注意人物和活动的对应关系。
【总结】判断正误题要注意张冠李戴的错误，如把妈妈的爱好说成爸爸的。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Dolphins are very smart animals. They live in the sea. They are not fish. They are mammals. Dolphins breathe air. They must come to the top of the water to breathe. Dolphins eat fish. They like to play and jump out of the water. They can swim very fast. Dolphins live in groups. They talk to each other with sounds. People like dolphins because they are friendly and cute.

(1) Where do dolphins live?
A. In the river B. In the sea C. In the lake D. On the land

(2) Dolphins are ______.
A. fish B. insects C. mammals D. birds

(3) What do dolphins eat?
A. Grass B. Meat C. Fish D. Fruit

(4) Why do people like dolphins?
A. Because they are big. B. Because they are friendly and cute.

analysis:
【考点】本题考查动物说明文的细节理解。
【解题思路】在文中直接定位关键词（live, mammals, eat, friendly, sounds）。
【总结】说明文选择题答案通常可直接在原文中找到，注意区分相似概念（如fish vs mammals）。

subject: english
question:

There are many kinds of sports. Some people like running. It is easy and cheap. You only need a pair of shoes. Some people like swimming. It is good for your health. ________________________________________
(2) What is good for your health?

answer:

analysis:
【考点】本题考查运动话题的信息提取和完整句回答。
【解题思路】在文中找到对应句子，用完整句子作答。
【总结】回答What问题时，主语+is/are+表语是最基本的句式结构。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

We should eat healthy food every day. For breakfast, we can have bread, eggs, and milk. For lunch, we can have rice, vegetables, and some meat. For dinner, we can have noodles or soup. We should eat more fruit and vegetables. Apples, bananas, and oranges are good for us. We should not eat too much candy or fast food. They are not healthy. Drinking water is also important. We should drink about eight glasses of water every day.

选择正确答案。
(1) What can we have for breakfast?
A. Rice and meat B. Bread, eggs, and milk C. Noodles D. Candy

(2) How many glasses of water should we drink every day?
A. Five B. Six C. Seven D. About eight

判断正误。
(3) We should eat more candy. (　)
(4) Fruit and vegetables are good for us. (　)
(5) Fast food is healthy food. (　)
analysis:
【考点】本题考查健康饮食话题的混合题型。
【解题思路】选择题在文中定位关键词，判断题比对原文细节。
【总结】健康类文章常见表达：be good for, should/should not, too much。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，将下列事件按文中发生的顺序排序（1-5）。

It is Monday today. I got up at 6:30. Then I washed my face and brushed my teeth. After that, I had breakfast. I ate bread and drank a glass of milk. At 7:20, I went to school by bus. School started at 8:00. I had four classes in the morning. At 12:00, I had lunch at school. In the afternoon, I had two more classes. After school, I went home and did my homework. Then I had dinner with my family at 6:00.

事件：
A. Had breakfast.
B. Had dinner with family.
C. Went to school by bus.
D. Got up at 6:30.
E. Did homework after school.

正确的顺序是：____ → ____ → ____ → ____ → ____
analysis:
【考点】本题考查日常作息的时间排序。
【解题思路】按时间线：起床→吃早餐→坐公交上学→放学做作业→和家人吃晚饭。
【总结】排序题要抓住具体时间点和顺序词（then, after that, after school）。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Hello! My name is Wang Ming. I am eleven years old. There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my sister and me. My father is a policeman. He is tall and strong. My mother is a nurse. analysis:
【考点】本题考查家庭介绍类文章的细节提取。
【解题思路】在文中逐一定位年龄、人数、职业、工作地点等信息。
【总结】人物介绍类文章要分清每个人的特征，不要混淆。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，判断句子正误，正确的写T，错误的写F。

It is spring now. The weather is getting warm. The trees are turning green. Flowers are coming out everywhere. Birds are singing in the trees. It often rains in spring. The rain helps plants grow. People like to go out for a walk. Children like flying kites in the park. Spring is a beautiful season. Many people say spring is their favorite season.

(1) It is autumn now. (　)
(2) The weather is getting warm. (　)

analysis:
【考点】本题考查季节与天气的细节判断。
【解题思路】与原文逐句比对，注意季节名称和天气现象的准确对应。
【总结】季节类文章常考天气特征和活动，注意snow与rain的区别。

subject: english
question:

Today is Saturday. Lisa and her mom went to the supermarket. They needed to buy some things for the week. First, they went to the fruit section. They bought some apples, bananas, and grapes. Then they went to the vegetable section. They bought tomatoes and potatoes. After that, they bought some milk and bread. Lisa wanted to buy some chocolate, but her mom said no. "Too much chocolate is not good for you," her mom said. At last, they paid at the checkout and went home.

(1) Where did Lisa and her mom go?
________________________________________
(2) What fruit did they buy?
________________________________________

________________________________________

answer:

【总结】回答Why/Why not问题必须给出原因，常用because连接。注意否定句的回答格式。

subject: english
question:

There are many jobs in the world. Teachers work in schools. They teach students. Doctors work in hospitals. They help sick people. Firefighters put out fires. They are very brave. analysis:
【考点】本题考查职业和工作场所的匹配。
【解题思路】在文中逐一定位每种职业的工作内容和地点。
【总结】职业类文章要分清每种职业的对应场所和职责，最后一句常出主旨题。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

People travel in many ways. Some people go to work by bus. It is cheap but sometimes slow. Some people go by car. It is fast but cars cost a lot of money. Some people ride bicycles. Riding a bicycle is good exercise and it is good for the environment. Many students walk to school if they live near the school. In big cities, many people take the subway. It is fast and not expensive. When people travel to far places, they go by plane. It is the fastest way to travel.

选择正确答案。
(1) Which is good for the environment?

(2) How do many people travel in big cities?

(3) What is the fastest way to travel?

analysis:
【考点】本题考查交通方式的细节理解和判断。
【解题思路】选择题定位关键词，判断题注意比较级和优缺点的对应。
【总结】交通类文章注意每种方式的优缺点（cheap/expensive, fast/slow），不能张冠李戴。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Our Earth is getting warmer. This is called global warming. Why is this happening? One reason is that people burn too much coal and oil. This sends a lot of carbon dioxide into the air. Another reason is that people cut down too many trees. Trees can absorb carbon dioxide. Without trees, there is more carbon dioxide in the air. Global warming is bad for the Earth. Ice is melting at the North and South Poles. Sea levels are rising. Some animals are losing their homes. We should do something to help. We can plant more trees. We can ride bicycles instead of driving cars. We can save water and electricity.

(1) What is global warming?
A. The Earth is getting colder. B. The Earth is getting warmer.
C. The Earth is getting bigger. D. The Earth is getting smaller.

(2) Why is global warming happening?
A. Because people plant too many trees. B. Because people burn too much coal and oil.
C. Because people save water. D. Because people ride bicycles.

(3) What can trees do according to the passage?
A. Produce coal B. Absorb carbon dioxide C. Burn oil D. Make electricity

(4) What does the writer imply about global warming?
A. It is not a serious problem.
B. Only scientists can solve it.
C. Everyone should do something to help.
D. It will stop by itself.

(5) What is NOT mentioned as a way to help?
A. Planting trees B. Riding bicycles C. Saving water D. Recycling paper
analysis:
【考点】本题考查环保话题的细节理解和推断题。
【解题思路】细节题直接定位，推断题从"We should do something to help"推出作者观点。
【总结】推断题（imply/infer）答案不会直接写在文中，需要根据文章整体语气和结论句推理。NOT题用排除法。

subject: english
question:

The Mid-Autumn Festival is an important Chinese festival. It is on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month. On this day, the moon is round and bright. Families get together and have a big dinner. People eat mooncakes. Mooncakes are round, like the moon. They are sweet and delicious. Children like to play with lanterns. Some people stay up late to enjoy the moon. The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion. People who are far from home miss their families very much on this day.

(1) When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?

analysis:
【考点】本题考查节日文化和主旨题。
【解题思路】主旨题看全文反复出现的主题——中秋节。细节题在文中直接定位。
【总结】主旨题（best title）的答案要能概括全文核心内容，不能只涵盖某个细节。

subject: english
question:

Lily and Emma are best friends. They met in Grade 3. They sit together in class. They share their lunch every day. Lily is good at math. She often helps Emma with math homework. Emma is good at drawing. She draws pictures for Lily's birthday cards. They walk home together after school. Sometimes they argue, but they always make up quickly. Last week, Emma was sick and didn't come to school for three days. Lily called her every evening to ask how she felt. When Emma came back to school, Lily brought her some fruit.

判断正误。
(1) Lily and Emma met in Grade 1. (　)
(2) Emma is good at math. (　)
(3) Lily called Emma when she was sick. (　)

选择正确答案。
(4) What can we learn about their friendship from the passage?
A. They never argue.
B. They only help each other with homework.
C. They care about each other very much.

【考点】本题考查友谊主题的判断、推断和词义猜测。
【解题思路】推断题从多个细节（分享午餐、打电话、带水果）综合推理；词义猜测从上下文语境推理。
【总结】推断题需要综合多个细节得出结论；词义猜测要结合上下文语境，不能只看字面意思。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Robots are very useful today. In factories, robots can do dangerous work. They can carry heavy things. They never get tired. In hospitals, robots can help doctors. Some robots can do simple operations. At home, robots can clean the floor and cook food. Some robots can even talk to people. Children like to play with robot toys. But robots cannot think like people. They can only do what people tell them to do. In the future, robots may do more things for us.

(1) Where can robots do dangerous work?
A. In schools B. In factories C. In libraries D. In parks

A. They can teach children. B. They can clean the floor and cook.
C. They can drive cars. D. They can fix computers.

(3) What does the word "operations" mean in this passage?
A. Math calculations B. Business activities
C. Medical surgeries D. Computer programs

(4) What is a limitation of robots according to the passage?
A. They cannot carry heavy things.
B. They cannot work in factories.
C. They cannot think like people.
D. They cannot talk.

C. Robots will take over the world. D. Robots will not change.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查科技话题的细节理解、词义猜测和推断。
【解题思路】词义猜测从上下文（hospitals, doctors）推断operations为手术；推断从最后一句推理。
【总结】词义猜测题要根据上下文语境，特别是前后出现的关联词（hospitals, doctors → operations = 手术）。

subject: english
question:

________________________________________

【解题思路】在文中逐一定位答案，用完整句子作答。
【总结】旅行类文章注意地点、交通方式、景点名称和美食等关键信息，回答时要准确转述原文。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Water is very important for all living things. Without water, there would be no life on Earth. Water goes around in a cycle. First, the sun heats the water in rivers, lakes, and seas. The water becomes water vapor and goes up into the sky. This is called evaporation. When the water vapor goes high up, it becomes cool and forms clouds. This is called condensation. When the clouds become heavy with water, rain or snow falls down. This is called precipitation. The water goes back into rivers and seas. Then the cycle starts again.

(1) What happens when the sun heats water?
A. It becomes ice. B. It becomes water vapor.
C. It becomes clouds. D. It becomes rain.

(2) What is the process of water vapor forming clouds called?
A. Evaporation B. Condensation C. Precipitation D. Heating

(3) What happens when clouds become heavy with water?
A. The sun comes out. B. Rain or snow falls down.
C. The water evaporates. D. The clouds disappear.

(4) What is this passage mainly about?
A. Why the sun is hot B. How to save water
C. The water cycle D. Different kinds of clouds

(5) What can we learn from the passage?
A. Water only comes from rain.
B. The water cycle never stops.
C. Evaporation happens at night.
D. Clouds are made of smoke.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查科普文章的细节理解和主旨题。
【解题思路】主旨题看全文核心话题——水循环；推断从"the cycle starts again"推出循环不停。
【总结】科普类文章要注意专业术语和定义的对应关系，主旨题要抓住全文反复出现的核心词（water cycle）。

subject: english
question:

subject: english
question:

subject: english
question:

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Pandas are one of the most famous animals in China. They are black and white. They are very cute. Pandas live in the forests of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu. Their favorite food is bamboo. A panda can eat about 30 kilograms of bamboo every day! Pandas spend most of their time eating and sleeping. Baby pandas are very small when they are born. They are pink and weigh only about 100 grams. There are not many pandas in the world. They are endangered animals. China is working hard to protect pandas. Many nature reserves have been built for them.

(1) What color are pandas?

(2) How much bamboo can a panda eat every day?
A. About 10 kilograms B. About 20 kilograms
C. About 30 kilograms D. About 40 kilograms

(3) What does the word "endangered" mean in this passage?
A. Dangerous to people B. Very strong
C. In danger of disappearing D. Very healthy

(4) What is China doing to help pandas?
A. Building nature reserves B. Sending them to zoos
C. Feeding them fish D. Teaching them to swim

(5) What is the best title for this passage?
A. Animals in China B. The Cute Pandas
C. How to Protect Animals D. Bamboo Forests
analysis:
【考点】本题考查动物说明文的细节理解、词义猜测和主旨题。
【解题思路】词义猜测从"not many pandas"和"protect"推出endangered为濒危的；主旨从全文核心话题判断。
【总结】词义猜测要结合上下文线索，如"not many""protect"暗示物种稀少需要保护。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，用完整的英语句子回答问题。

Our school has many clubs. Students can choose the club they like. The Art Club meets on Monday afternoons. Students paint and draw pictures there. The Music Club meets on Tuesdays. Students sing songs and play instruments. The Sports Club meets on Wednesdays and Fridays. Students play basketball, football, and table tennis. The Science Club meets on Thursdays. Students do interesting experiments. I joined the Art Club because I like drawing. My friend Tom joined the Science Club. He wants to be a scientist when he grows up.

(1) When does the Art Club meet?
________________________________________
(2) What do students do in the Music Club?
________________________________________
(3) Which club meets on Wednesdays and Fridays?
________________________________________
(4) Why did the writer join the Art Club?
________________________________________
(5) What does Tom want to be when he grows up?
________________________________________
answer:
(1) The Art Club meets on Monday afternoons.
(2) They sing songs and play instruments.
(3) The Sports Club meets on Wednesdays and Fridays.
(4) Because the writer likes drawing.
(5) He wants to be a scientist.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查学校社团活动的时间、活动和原因提取。
【解题思路】在文中找到每个社团对应的日期、活动和原因。
【总结】回答Why问题用Because开头；回答When问题要给出具体时间；回答What用完整描述。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

Sleep is very important for children. Most children need 9 to 11 hours of sleep every night. Good sleep helps children grow and learn better. But many children do not get enough sleep. Some children stay up late playing games or watching TV. This is a bad habit. Here are some tips for good sleep. First, go to bed at the same time every night. Second, don't drink tea or cola before bed. Third, don't use phones or tablets in bed. The light from screens makes it hard to fall asleep. Fourth, read a book or listen to quiet music before sleep. These will help you relax.

判断正误。
(1) Most children need only 5 hours of sleep. (　)
(2) Playing games before bed is a good habit. (　)
(3) Screen light can make it hard to fall asleep. (　)

选择正确答案。
(4) What does the writer imply about phones and tablets?
A. They are good for sleep.
B. They are not good to use before sleep.
C. They help children learn better.
D. They are the same as books.

(5) What is the passage mainly about?
A. How to play games B. Why sleep is important and tips for good sleep
C. How to use phones D. What to drink before bed
analysis:
【考点】本题考查健康睡眠话题的判断、推断和主旨。
【解题思路】推断从"light from screens makes it hard to fall asleep"推出不建议睡前用手机。
【总结】推断题要根据文中证据推理，不能凭主观判断。主旨要概括全文两大部分：为什么重要+怎么做。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China. It is also called Chinese New Year. It usually comes in January or February. Before the Spring Festival, people clean their houses. They buy new clothes and lots of food. On New Year's Eve, families have a big dinner together. They eat dumplings, fish, and many other dishes. After dinner, people usually watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV. Children like the Spring Festival very much because they can get red envelopes with money inside. People visit relatives and friends during the holiday. They say "Happy New Year" to each other. The Spring Festival usually lasts for about 15 days.

(1) What is another name for the Spring Festival?
A. Mid-Autumn Festival B. Dragon Boat Festival C. Chinese New Year D. Lantern Festival

(2) What do people do before the Spring Festival?
A. Clean their houses B. Go swimming C. Plant trees D. Fly kites

(3) Why do children like the Spring Festival?
A. Because they can swim. B. Because they can get red envelopes.
C. Because they can plant trees. D. Because they can go to school.

(4) What is the passage mainly about?
A. Chinese food B. Chinese holidays C. Spring Festival traditions D. Family dinners

(5) How long does the Spring Festival usually last?
A. About 7 days B. About 10 days C. About 15 days D. About 30 days
analysis:
【考点】本题考查春节文化的细节和主旨。
【解题思路】主旨看全文核心——春节传统习俗。细节题在文中直接定位。
【总结】主旨题的答案要涵盖文章的主要方面，不能只涵盖某个细节（如family dinners只是其中一部分）。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Plants are very important. They give us food to eat and oxygen to breathe. Most plants have roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits. Roots grow under the ground. They take in water from the soil. Stems carry water from roots to leaves. Leaves are very important because they make food for the plant. They use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food. This process is called photosynthesis. Flowers are beautiful and colorful. They attract insects. Insects help plants make seeds. Some plants grow from seeds. Some plants grow from stems or leaves.

(1) What do plants give us?
A. Water and soil B. Food and oxygen C. Sunlight and rain D. Coal and oil

(2) What do roots do?
A. They make food. B. They carry water to leaves.
C. They take in water from the soil. D. They attract insects.

(3) What does "photosynthesis" mean in this passage?
A. A way plants breathe B. The process of plants making food using sunlight
C. How plants grow from seeds D. The way flowers attract insects

(4) Why are leaves important?
A. Because they are colorful. B. Because they attract insects.
C. Because they make food for the plant. D. Because they grow under the ground.

(5) What helps plants make seeds?
A. Wind B. Rain C. Insects D. Roots
analysis:
【考点】本题考查植物科学知识及词义猜测。
【解题思路】词义猜测从"use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make food"推出photosynthesis的含义。
【总结】科学类文章要注意定义句的格式（This process is called...），这往往是词义猜测题的线索。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

My dog Max is my best friend. He is a golden retriever. He has golden fur and big brown eyes. Every morning, Max wakes me up. He jumps on my bed and licks my face. After school, Max waits for me at the door. When I come in, he wags his tail happily. We go for a walk in the park every day. Max likes to chase balls. He can run very fast. One rainy day, I felt sad because I couldn't go out. Max came and sat next to me. He put his head on my lap. I felt much better. Max can always tell when I am sad. He is the best dog in the world.

(1) What kind of dog is Max?
A. A small white dog B. A golden retriever C. A black dog D. A brown poodle

(2) What does Max do every morning?
A. He goes for a walk alone. B. He watches TV.
C. He wakes the writer up. D. He plays in the park.

(3) What does Max do when the writer comes home?
A. He hides under the bed. B. He wags his tail happily.
C. He goes to sleep. D. He runs away.

(4) What can we learn about Max from the passage?
A. He only cares about food.
B. He does not like the writer.
C. He understands the writer's feelings.
D. He prefers to be alone.

(5) What is the best title for this passage?
A. How to Train a Dog B. Dogs in the Park
C. My Best Friend Max D. A Rainy Day
analysis:
【考点】本题考查宠物类记叙文的细节理解和推断。
【解题思路】推断从"Max can always tell when I am sad"推出Max能理解主人情感。
【总结】推断题要找文中的行为描述作为证据（如舔脸、摇尾巴、把头放在腿上），从行为推理情感。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Every day, people produce a lot of rubbish. Where does it all go? Most rubbish is buried in the ground in places called landfills. But landfills are getting full. We need to produce less rubbish. One way to do this is to recycle. Recycling means turning old things into new things. We can recycle paper, glass, plastic, and metal. When we recycle paper, we save trees. When we recycle glass, we save sand and energy. Recycling also helps reduce pollution. But recycling is not the only answer. We should also reduce the amount of things we use, and reuse things when possible. This is called the "3Rs" — Reduce, Reuse, Recycle. If everyone follows the 3Rs, our planet will be cleaner and healthier.

(1) Where is most rubbish buried?
A. In the sea B. In landfills C. In rivers D. In parks

(2) What does "recycle" mean in this passage?
A. To throw things away B. To buy new things
C. To turn old things into new things D. To burn old things

(3) What do we save when we recycle paper?
A. Water B. Sand C. Trees D. Metal

(4) What does the writer imply about the 3Rs?
A. Recycling alone can solve all problems.
B. Only adults should follow the 3Rs.
C. All three actions are needed to protect the planet.
D. The 3Rs are too difficult for most people.

(5) What can we infer from the last sentence?
A. The planet is already clean enough.
B. Individual actions can make a difference to the environment.
C. Only factories cause pollution.
D. The 3Rs are a new idea.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查环保话题的细节理解、词义猜测和深层推断。
【解题思路】词义猜测从后文"turning old things into new things"直接得出定义；推断题从"If everyone follows"推出个人行动的力量。
【总结】推断题答案在文中无直接表述，需要从文章整体论证方向和结论句推理。3Rs的关系是递进的——三者缺一不可。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

The Internet is a wonderful tool. We can learn new things, play games, and talk to friends online. But the Internet can also be dangerous, especially for children. Some strangers on the Internet may not be who they say they are. They may try to get your personal information, like your name, address, or phone number. You should never share personal information with strangers online. Also, be careful about what you post. Once something is on the Internet, it is very hard to remove. Cyberbullying is another problem. Some people write mean things online to hurt others. If someone is unkind to you online, tell a parent or teacher right away. The Internet can be safe if you use it wisely.

(1) What may strangers on the Internet try to do?
A. Help with homework B. Get your personal information
C. Send you gifts D. Teach you new things

(2) What does "cyberbullying" mean in this passage?
A. Studying online B. Playing online games
C. Hurting others by writing mean things online D. Making friends online

(3) What should you do if someone is unkind to you online?
A. Write mean things back B. Keep it a secret
C. Tell a parent or teacher D. Stop using the Internet forever

(4) What does the writer imply about things posted on the Internet?
A. They can be easily deleted anytime.
B. Only your friends can see them.
C. They may stay online permanently even if you try to remove them.
D. They are always safe.

(5) What is the main idea of this passage?
A. The Internet is only dangerous.
B. How to play games online safely.
C. The Internet is useful but children need to use it safely.
D. How to make friends online.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查网络安全话题的细节理解、词义猜测、推断和主旨。
【解题思路】词义猜测从后文解释句推出；推断从"very hard to remove"推出永久性；主旨从首尾句概括。
【总结】难篇常同时出现多种题型。词义猜测看紧跟的定义句或举例句；推断题注意"hard to remove"的深层含义。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

The solar system has eight planets. They all go around the sun. The four planets closest to the sun are Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. They are called inner planets. The other four — Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune — are called outer planets. Jupiter is the biggest planet. Saturn has beautiful rings around it. Earth is the only planet that we know has life. It has water and air, which are necessary for living things. Mars is called the "Red Planet" because it looks red. Scientists have sent many spacecraft to explore Mars. They want to find out if there was ever life on Mars. Some scientists believe that humans may live on Mars in the future, but this would be very difficult.

(1) How many planets are there in the solar system?
A. Six B. Seven C. Eight D. Nine

(2) Which planet is the biggest?
A. Earth B. Mars C. Saturn D. Jupiter

(3) What does "explore" mean in this passage?
A. To destroy B. To study and discover C. To build D. To fly over

(4) Why is Earth special among the planets?
A. It is the biggest planet.
B. It is the closest to the sun.
C. It is the only planet known to have life.
D. It has rings around it.

(5) What can we infer about living on Mars in the future?
A. It will be easy and fun.
B. It is already happening now.
C. It is possible but would be very challenging.
D. Scientists have given up on the idea.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查太空科学话题的细节理解、词义猜测和推断。
【解题思路】词义猜测从"sent spacecraft""find out"推出explore为探索发现；推断从"may live"和"very difficult"推出。
【总结】科普类推断题要注意情态动词（may, might）和程度副词（very difficult）的暗示，推理答案不能过于绝对。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，选择正确答案。

Reading is a good habit. It can help us learn new words and improve our writing. But not everyone likes reading. Some children think reading is boring. They prefer playing video games or watching videos. However, reading has many advantages that screens cannot provide. When you read a story, you use your imagination to picture the characters and places. When you watch a video, everything is shown to you. Reading also helps you concentrate better. Studies show that children who read regularly do better in school. To develop a reading habit, start with books you enjoy. You don't have to read thick books. Comic books, magazines, and storybooks are all fine. Try to read for 20 minutes before bed every night. Soon, you may find that reading is actually fun.

(1) What can reading help us do?
A. Learn new words and improve writing B. Play video games better
C. Watch more videos D. Sleep less

(2) What does "concentrate" mean in this passage?
A. To forget things easily B. To focus attention on something
C. To get tired quickly D. To move around a lot

(3) What advantage does reading have over watching videos?
A. Reading is louder. B. Reading is faster.
C. Reading uses imagination. D. Reading has more pictures.

(4) What does the writer imply about children who don't like reading?
A. They will never learn to read.
B. They can learn to enjoy reading if they start with what they like.
C. They are not smart.
D. They should be forced to read difficult books.

(5) What is the main idea of this passage?
A. Video games are bad for children.
B. Reading is important and everyone can develop the habit.
C. Children should only read thick books.
D. Schools should give more homework.
analysis:
【考点】本题考查阅读习惯话题的全方位理解，包含细节、词义猜测、推断和主旨。
【解题思路】词义从"helps you concentrate better"和"do better in school"推出；推断从"start with books you enjoy"推出。
【总结】本篇为综合性高难度文章。推断题要注意文章的建议部分（"start with books you enjoy"），这暗示了解决方案。

subject: english
question:
阅读下面短文，完成题目。

Beijing is a fascinating city. It is the capital of China and has a history of over 3,000 years. Millions of tourists visit Beijing every year. The most famous place is the Great Wall. It is one of the longest walls in the world. It was built to protect China from enemies. The Forbidden City is another must-see place. It was the home of emperors for hundreds of years. Now it is a museum. You can see many treasures there. Beijing also has beautiful parks, such as the Summer Palace and the Temple of Heaven. In the old parts of Beijing, there are hutongs. These are narrow streets with traditional houses. Walking through hutongs is like traveling back in time. Beijing is a city where the ancient and modern exist side by side. You can see tall buildings and old temples next to each other.

判断正误。
(1) The Great Wall was built to welcome visitors. (　)
(2) The Forbidden City is now a museum. (　)

选择正确答案。
(3) What does "fascinating" mean in this passage?
A. Very boring B. Very interesting and attractive C. Very old and broken D. Very small

(4) What can we infer about hutongs?
A. They are new and modern.
B. They show the traditional lifestyle of old Beijing.
C. Nobody lives in hutongs anymore.
D. They are the same as tall buildings.

(5) What is the passage mainly about?
A. The food in Beijing
B. Beijing as a city rich in history and culture
C. How to travel to Beijing
D. Modern buildings in China
analysis:
【考点】本题为综合性高难度文章，考查判断、词义猜测、推断和主旨。
【解题思路】词义从后文列举众多景点推出fascinating意为迷人的；推断从"traveling back in time"推出胡同代表传统。
【总结】词义猜测要看上下文的感情色彩和举例——列举众多著名景点说明fascinating是正面形容词。推断"like traveling back in time"暗示古老传统。
